typeBlock.description: This GDDI type is used to carry CCSDS TC (Tele-Command) frames in the GDDI payload with corresponding metadata used by recipients to process the data. From the ground system perspective: TC frames are the output of the TC Data Link 'sender' that has encapsulated uplink CCSDS_MAP_SDUs (e.g. BUS Space/Encap Packets and CFDP UT_SDUs) into the TC frames and parsed/attached the applicable metadata to this message. From the spacecraft perspective: TC frames are the output of the vehicle's TC Data Link 'receiver' that has processed an uplink decoded CLTU into a TC frame. Note that TM, AOS, and USLP transfer frames are a completely separate format which are carried in 'CCSDS Transfer Frame' GDDI messages, and the CCSDS version for TM frames overlaps with that of TC frames, driving distinctly separate formats. Also, there is only one CCSDS version for TC, precluding the need to transfer it as metadata at this time.

tlv.description: Space Craft ID associated with this 'CCSDS Telecommand Frame'. CCSDS TC max SCID is 1023. (Default: 0)
Virtual Channel ID associated with this 'CCSDS Telecommand Frame'. CCSDS TC max VCID is 63. (Default: 0)
Timestamp for this CCSDS Telecommand Frame, representing the number of non-leap seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)

Indicates if an error was detected in the received 'CCSDS Telecommand Frame'. Errors include: Uncorrectable BCH-decode errors, CCSDS CRC errors, Invalid TC Transfer Frame Versions, and/or Invalid Length. Note this metadata is only applicable to the receive-side of the CCSDS TC link, which is typically the spacecraft, but can also be the ground when performing an uplink loopback test. (Default: false)
